title: Pappas Cottage - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A Escapes presents “Pappas Cottage,” a luxurious Tuscan-inspired retreat in Rosemary Beach. Located right on Eastern Green with breathtaking Gulf views, it’s steps to the beach and community Coquina Pool. Relax in the private ocean-view courtyard with a dining
description_expanded: 30A Escapes presents “Pappas Cottage,” a luxurious Tuscan-inspired retreat in Rosemary Beach. Located right on Eastern Green with breathtaking Gulf views, it’s steps to the beach and community Coquina Pool. Relax in the private ocean-view courtyard with a dining area and grill, or enjoy nearby restaurants and shops on 6 beach bikes included. With 4 elegant suites, it accommodates up to 8 guests with ease. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Directly in front of the Eastern Green30-second walk to beach access with restrooms2-minute walk to Coquina PoolSteps to the pristine white sands of Rosemary BeachSecluded private courtyard featuring lush gardens, outdoor dining, and BBQ grillGulf views from the balcony and spacious second floorChef’s dream kitchen with stainless steel appliancesExterior laundry room with full-size washer/dryer, mini fridge and sink4 bedrooms, each with a private en-suiteIncludes 6 beach bikes for exploring the area3rd-floor loft for additional space and relaxationEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"We loved this house! It was the perfect location, well-appointed, and had a good layout to accommodate our guests. Perfect for a girls' weekend!" – Colleen M.⭐"Beautiful home with an ideal location to beach and pool. The layout was great for a family vacation, and the provided bikes were a great bonus!" – Richard E.*** LIVING AREAS ***The living spaces of Pappas Cottage bring together Old World charm and modern comforts. The first-floor living room boasts a brand-new sectional sofa and large flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights with family and friends. On the second floor, an open floor plan connects the living, dining, and kitchen spaces seamlessly, with expansive windows offering breathtaking views of the Gulf and Eastern Green.1st Floor Living Area: Cozy sectional sofa and flat-screen TV2nd Floor Open Space Living Area with Gulf views and plush sofas*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances, including a 5-burner gas range, dual ovens, and side-by-side Subzero refrigerator. Enjoy your meals at the elegant dining table with seating for 8, or take your coffee outside to the balcony for a quiet morning by the Gulf breeze.State-of-the-art appliances, including gas range and Subzero fridgeDining table seats 8 comfortablyBalcony with Gulf views, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Escape to your own private courtyard, surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant ivy accents. This secluded oasis offers an oversized outdoor dining table, a gas grill for barbecues, and plenty of space for kids to play freely. Plus, enjoy direct access to the beach, just a 30-second walk to the beach access with restrooms.Secluded courtyard with ivy accents and vibrant vegetationOutdoor dining table, accommodating groups comfortablyGas grill for effortless al fresco diningExterior Laundry room with washer, dryer, mini fridge and sinkDirect beach access, only 30 seconds away with convenient restrooms nearby*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each of Pappas Cottage’s 4 bedrooms is thoughtfully designed with comfort and convenience in mind, offering private en-suite bathrooms and premium furnishings.1st Floor:Primary King Suite with courtyard access and an en-suite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and double vanityQueen Guest Suite with en-suite bathroomTwin Bedroom with en-suite bathroom2nd Floor:Primary King Suite with en-suite bathroom and private balcony overlooking the CourtyardHalf Bath: Convenient for living area guests*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located on the South side of Rosemary Beach, Pappas Cottage is ideally positioned just steps from the beach and a short stroll to Coquina Pool. Take a quick bike ride (6 bikes included) to the vibrant boutique shops and restaurants of Rosemary Beach, or explore the nearby greens and parks perfect for families.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATIONS ***"Pappas Cottage" has a carriage house that rents separately. "Pappas Carriage" is a 1 bedroom that sleeps 2 with a full kitchen & living space.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is currently active construction across the green from this property. Please note that parking for this property is shared with the carriage house. There is 1 parking space in the garage for the main house & 1 for the carriage house.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 20818STRO #: STR-020818

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
